title: List re-renders on every keystroke
summary: A memoized list still renders while the user types in a sibling text box.

turns.text: Typing in the notes box on the practice page lags. The React DevTools Profiler shows PieceList rendering on every keystroke, even though it is wrapped in memo. Why, and what should I change?

memo only skips a render when every prop is the same as last time, so if PieceList still renders on each keystroke, some prop gets a new identity each time the page renders. I'll read what the page passes to it.
